materialClaims.claim: The August 18 AIDB episode proposes five AI-related skills for knowledge workers—capability mapping, context and harness management, problem and product prototyping, new-opportunity identification and rapid skill acquisition—on top of domain judgment.
materialClaims.dispositionReason: The dated transcript directly verifies the AIDB author's five-part framework and its stated Andrew Ng inspiration. The exact Andrew Ng post was not found, and the transcript does not independently establish that the five categories are complete, broadly adopted or outcome-proven.
